message.content: It’s hard to pick just one, but many critics and audiences crowned **“Parasite”** (2019) as the standout film of 2020—especially after it won Best Picture at the Oscars in early 2021. It was widely praised for its sharp social satire, genre‑blending storytelling, and masterful direction by Bong Joon‑ho. If you’re looking for something else, “1917,” “Joker,” and “Soul” also received significant acclaim that year.
